llm.summary: The skill is purpose-aligned and not obviously malicious, but it persistently changes agent behavior and can broadly read or write local memory without enough scoping or confirmation.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a deterministic memory/context pipeline, and the artifacts coherently implement routing, retrieval, compression, validation, and evidence checks for that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill directs agents to use the pipeline as default behavior for every user message, says casual prompts do not waive the workflow, and uses broad natural-language triggers for apply, routing, and memory commit behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The install/apply flow copies files into context_pipeline and instructs the agent to patch AGENTS.md, but it does not require a separate confirmation, preview, rollback path, or bounded install scope before changing persistent agent instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime retrieval reads broad local memory paths including MEMORY.md, memory/topics, now/open-loops, automation, and sometimes daily logs; this fits the purpose but is high-impact and can expose more private context than a specific task needs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The memory commit workflow appends or updates daily logs, now, open-loops, topic files, and MEMORY.md on broad phrases such as store this or we’ll continue later, without requiring a draft review or explicit per-file approval.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review this before installing if your workspace memory contains sensitive data. Only apply it if you want AGENTS.md changed so future agent replies use this memory pipeline by default, and require manual review of AGENTS.md diffs plus any memory writes. Avoid storing secrets in memory files, and remove the AGENTS.md section, context_pipeline directory, and .openclaw/context-runs artifacts if you decide to roll it back.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Local file reads, writes, and script execution are visible and purpose-aligned, but the package does not clearly bound those capabilities in metadata or require confirmation before persistent changes.
[SQP-1] expected: The default-behavior activation is part of the advertised workflow, but the natural-language activation examples and broad router terms make accidental or overbroad application plausible.
[SQP-2] expected: Writing local memory is expected for a memory pipeline, but the checklist stores session information persistently without a required preview, redaction step, or explicit consent checkpoint.
[SQP-3] expected: A default context-loading protocol is central to the skill, but applying retrieval/compression/evidence handling to every message is broader than many users may expect.
